					<description><![CDATA[Multimillionaire Brazilian art collector Bernardo Paz, the founder of museum and sculpture garden Instituto Inhotim, is developing a new museum and accompanying botanical garden that will sit directly next to Inhotim, according to reports. Paz is currently leading and funding the new, as yet unnamed museum project, which will eventually function as a nonprofit.  Like […]]]></description>

The submitted budget represents an 11% cut from the $1.08 billion allocated to the Smithsonian in 2026.  This move is just the latest in a long series of deliberate attempts […]]]></description>

					<description><![CDATA[Artist and curator Michelle Grabner has donated over 2000 pieces of artwork to the John Michael Kohler Arts Center (JMKAC) in Sheboygan, Wisconsin. The gift makes JMKAC the single largest holder of Grabner’s works in the world.  The donated works span across Grabner’s career beginning in the 1990s and consist of 1200 prints and photographs, […]]]></description>

His death was announced by his gallery in an Instagram post, which noted that Cordero “passed away peacefully surrounded by what he loved the most—his chosen family, laughter and so much […]]]></description>

					<description><![CDATA[Today, Art Week NYC announced the participating galleries for its inaugural citywide event taking place November 11–14, 2026. The gallery program, presented by Artforum, is the cornerstone of the inaugural event, bringing together more than 76 world renowned galleries shaping the contemporary art world.  Participating galleries include Hauser & Wirth, Gagosian, David Zwirner, Pace Gallery, Lisson, Paula Cooper Gallery, and many others across New York’s gallery districts, […]]]></description>

Over 90% of members voted on action, with nearly 77% of those favoring strike action. Operating out of Greenwich’s UNESCO World Heritage site, RMG represents four cultural institutions in London: […]]]></description>

Drawing on changing attitudes toward process-based art and Conceptualism in the early 1970s, Borden identified the emergence of competing “inductive and deductive” methodologies in […]]]></description>
